{{- /* creator/megamenu.html — "The Garden ▾" (arch/26 §2.3). Shown only when the site has top-level folders; then on every page. Lists ALL top-level folders (no truncation, no 2nd level), 2-column grid, icon (folder index.md `icon` → keyword → seedling) + title + description. */ -}} {{- $_ := partial "creator/nodes.html" . -}}{{- $nodes := .Scratch.Get "creatorNodes" -}} {{- $folders := where (where $nodes "parent" "") "g" 0 -}} {{- if $folders -}} {{- $folders = partial "creator/sort-pages.html" (dict "nodes" $folders "by" "menu") | transform.Unmarshal -}}
{{- range $folders -}} {{ partial "creator/folder-icon.html" (dict "node" . "size" 24) }} {{ .title }} {{- with .desc }}{{ . }}{{ end }} {{- end -}}
{{- $tags := "tags/" | relURL -}} {{- with $.Site.GetPage "tags" -}}{{- $tags = .RelPermalink -}}{{- end -}} {{ i18n "creator.allTags" }} {{ partial "creator/icon.html" (dict "name" "arrow-right" "size" 16) }}
{{- end -}}
